question: THE PARTICLE-SECTOR STATEMENT -- the framework's complete particle physics in one document: (1) assembled from the committed B-series (B01-B09) and A-wave (A01-A08): the mass ladder, the 2.55-keV line, the X-ray temperature law, the dark-gas thermodynamics, the condensate face, the decoupling history, the baryon input, the m_e/100 curiosity; (2) the testable-predictions table (17 rows, instrument/date/falsifier); (3) the honest boundaries (decay rate, coupling, baryon fraction if B9 fails); (4) verdicts V1/V2/V3.
assembly_sources: B01 (line profile: width 1.19 eV, F(b) shape, never-froze absence)
B02 (line-flux map: the b^-1 cusp, the lifetime bound from the bgd)
B03 (the multi-rung test: one mass from every environment that froze)
B04 (the 3-Z^2 sequence test: m_e/100 a single coincidence)
B05 (dark-gas thermodynamics: sound speed response, heat capacity)
B06 (T_X-ray law full sample + inverse mass estimator)
B07 (decoupling history: condensed at z* = 2.4, not a relic gas)
B08 (condensate face: collective modes, no-heating, smoothness)
B09 (baryon input: the pin attempt, honestly failed)

mass_ladder.m_keV: 5.09 +- 0.10 (G212; ladder band [4.9992, 5.1887] vs measured [4.99, 5.19], central -0.05 sigma, A08)
mass_ladder.multi_rung: 11 frozen rungs recover m in [5.0000, 5.0001] keV, spread 0.00012 keV = 0.001 sigma of the G212 band (B03)
mass_ladder.environment_blindness: all frozen rungs invert to the same 5.00 keV footing; the UFD class (z* < 0) is the massless rung (B03/A06)

the_line.width: sigma_E = 1.19 eV (envelope [1.19, 8.08] eV), Doppler-dominated, never intrinsic (B01)
the_line.F_b_shape: I(b) = pi A_ph/b + 2 A_d K(0.7) b^-0.7: b^-1 cusp vs NFW flat core, rate-independent (B01/B02)
the_line.environmental_absence: present in the frozen class, absent in the never-froze 34 dSphs (z* < 0) (B01)
the_line.lifetime_bound: Gamma < 1.88e-29 s^-1 cosmic (tau > 1.69e12 yr) / 3.30e-33 s^-1 MW (tau > 9.6e15 yr): always a bound (B02)

xray_temperature_law.mp_rung: T_X-ray = mu m_p sqrt(G M_b a0)/(2 k_B), zero-parameter (A02)
xray_temperature_law.full_sample: 50 objects, 3 samples: within-sample MAD 0.053 dex at the 0.062 benchmark (B06)
xray_temperature_law.inverse_estimator: M_impl = 4 (k_B T/(mu m_p))^2/(G a0): 0.10-0.36 dex = 2x the T scatter, SZ-class (B06)

dark_gas_thermodynamics.eos: P = sigma^2 rho, gamma = 1 EXACT, C_V = N k_B, C_p = inf, kappa_T = 1/sigma^2 (B05)
dark_gas_thermodynamics.sound_speed_response: c_s = sigma r-independent; t_sound/t_dyn = sqrt(2) EXACT; HeCS c/c_s = 327 (B05)
dark_gas_thermodynamics.heat_capacity: Q_1K = N k_B = 1.97e50 J (MW) / 6.9e53 J (HeCS); dT_rms/T = 2.65e-37 scale-invariant (B05)

condensate_face.collective_modes: omega(k) = c_s k, gap EXACTLY 0, growth 0, damping 0 (G081 marginal; B08)
condensate_face.no_heating: Landau v_c = c_s + collisionless 1e73-1e76 t_H; T_b fixed at 9.52-9.69 K; Bullet ordered, not heated (B08)
condensate_face.smoothness: shot noise 1/sqrt(N_ph) = 2.55e-37; R(k) = 1; no phantom substructure (B08)

decoupling_history.statement: the freeze IS the decoupling: T_b = 9.338 K, z* = 2.426 in [2.3656, 2.4932]; occupation 10^(-2.8e6): NOT a thermal relic population (B07)
decoupling_history.density: rho(z*) = 1.39e-20 kg/m^3 = 1.32e5 x the cosmic mean at z*: condensed by its freeze epoch (B07)
decoupling_history.imprint: bias = 1 by construction; no free-streaming cut, R(k) = 1, Delta N_eff ~ 0 (B07/S07)

baryon_input.pin_attempt: f_b = <s_b>/0.54 = 0.1567 vs 0.1564 (+0.2%) -- an identity on measured sides; two-rung band [0.150, 0.157]; systematics [0.139, 0.180] (B09)
baryon_input.decision: NOT pinned: f_b = 0.157 remains an input, halo-anchored at 4%; six core inputs = 4 measured + 1 identity-pinned + 1 derived (B09)

me100_curiosity.sequence_verdict: 3-Z^2 SEQUENCE CLOSED: 1 survivor (the A01 hook, by construction), 0 additional members, E_chance 0.10 = 300x the family-wise gate (B04)

rows.falsifier: object outside the 0.06-dex band; sample scatter > 0.12 dex

decoupling epoch z* = 2.4: BTFR zeros flat below, break at z*
environment-blindness: one mass from every frozen rung

honest_boundaries.decay_rate: NOT predicted: no coupling constant exists; the rate is a bound (Gamma < 1.9e-29 / 3.3e-33 s^-1), never a value (A05/B02)
honest_boundaries.coupling_mixing_production: NOT predicted: sin^2 2theta and any production channel are outside the framework; sterile-class illustrations UNVERIFIED (A05)
honest_boundaries.spin_statistics_ontology: committed face = charge (R(k) = 1); relic disfavored (3.2-4.1 sigma) but formal G156 declaration awaits the 95% SHMF inversion at M_hm in [5e5, 5.8e6] (G234/S07)
honest_boundaries.baryon_fraction_if_B9_fails: f_b = 0.157 NOT predicted: the depletion chain closes arithmetically (0.1567, +0.2%) as an identity on measured sides; zero framework mechanisms; f_b remains the last measured input, halo-anchored at 4% (B09/S05)
honest_boundaries.mp_mu: proton mass enters as the unit of the baryonic rung by construction; the framework does NOT establish m_p or mu; m/m_p ratios are equal-sigma identities (A02)
honest_boundaries.SM_mass_ratios: CLOSED: phase-1 null stands, A04 joins it (0 certified / 0 survivors), B04 sequence closed (A04/B04)
